name: A funeral
prompt: Someone you knew from school has died. The funeral is this afternoon, across town.

outcome.told: You think about them on and off all day.
outcome.line: {you} did not go to the funeral of someone from school.

outcome.told: The florist reads your card back to you over the phone.
You stand at the back. Afterwards, people you haven't seen in years say your name.
outcome.line: {you} went to the funeral of someone from school.
